## extensions.kt { #extensions-kt }

Box actions: named commands a box registers in its `actions` map, which resync gathers from the
box and its ancestors and sends to the UI.

An [`Action`](internal.md#extensions-kt-action) carries a short description, a detail line, optional HTML or JavaScript
documentation, and a `target` callback that receives the boxes it was invoked on. [`action`](internal.md#extensions-kt--action) builds
one with the callback as a trailing lambda.

## binding.kt { #binding-kt }

Binds a property or one-argument function to a source of values with the `<` operator:
`::speed < { mouseX }` or `::speed < sequenceOf(1.0, 2.0, 3.0)`.

The callable reference must be bound to a receiver implementing [`BoundContext`](internal.md#binding-kt-boundcontext); the binding is
stored there under the callable's name, replacing any earlier one. Each [`BoundContext.bindNow`](internal.md#binding-kt--boundcontext--bindnow)
pulls the next value from every source, type-checks it against the property or parameter type,
and applies it only when it differs from the last value applied. A sequence that runs out removes
its binding; `clear()` on the reference removes it by hand.

Nothing in `src/` implements [`BoundContext`](internal.md#binding-kt-boundcontext) or calls `bindNow` yet, so this is the mechanism
without a host.

## ManifoldNative.kt { #manifoldnative-kt }

The FFM binding to `libmanifoldc` that [`Solid`](graphics.md#solid-kt-solid) and [`Section`](graphics.md#section-kt-section) are built on, plus the small public enums they take.

Box code needs only [`ManifoldLibrary`](internal.md#manifoldnative-kt-manifoldlibrary), to ask whether the native library is installed, and the
option enums [`BooleanOp`](internal.md#manifoldnative-kt-booleanop), [`JoinType`](internal.md#manifoldnative-kt-jointype) and [`FillRule`](internal.md#manifoldnative-kt-fillrule); the native entry points themselves are internal.

## GestureReplayMain.kt { #gesturereplaymain-kt }

A command-line entry point that replays a recorded pen gesture through a brush and writes the
painted PNG, so an agent can try a gesture without a browser.

[`GestureReplayMain`](internal.md#gesturereplaymain-kt-gesturereplaymain) reads a [`GestureReplayRequest`](internal.md#gesturereplaymain-kt-gesturereplayrequest) (raw samples, or keyframe lanes in
[`GestureReplayLanes`](internal.md#gesturereplaymain-kt-gesturereplaylanes)) and prints a [`GestureReplayReport`](internal.md#gesturereplaymain-kt-gesturereplayreport) as JSON.

`src/jvmMain/kotlin/afield/graphics/paint/GestureReplayMain.kt` — [read the source](source/jvmMain/afield/graphics/paint/GestureReplayMain/)

### GestureReplayMain { #gesturereplaymain-kt-gesturereplaymain }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">object</span> <span class="nc">GestureReplayMain</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/graphics/paint/GestureReplayMain/#L37)

The gesture -> brush replay for an agent, without a browser: a take (or its keyframe lanes) in a JSON file, a painted PNG out. `field_backdoor.py --command 'run-jvm-main afield.graphics.paint.GestureReplayMain --arg <request.json>'`, or the MCP tool `field_paint_gesture`.

## FfmCeresBackend.kt { #ffmceresbackend-kt }

The Ceres solver backend that calls the native `ken_ceres_jvm` wrapper through the Java
foreign-function API (`java.lang.foreign`), with no JNI glue.

[`FfmCeresBackend`](internal.md#ffmceresbackend-kt-ffmceresbackend) loads the library, binds its `ken_ceres_*` entry points as downcall handles and
reports [`FfmCeresBackend.abiVersion`](internal.md#ffmceresbackend-kt--ffmceresbackend--abiversion); [`FfmCeresBackend.compile`](internal.md#ffmceresbackend-kt--ffmceresbackend--compile) turns a seed [`PointCloud`](solvers.md#ceresgeometry-kt-pointcloud) and a
[`CeresProgram`](solvers.md#ceresgeometry-kt-ceresprogram) into a reusable compiled solver whose input, output and prior buffers are allocated
once in a shared arena and reused across solves. [`CeresNativeLibrary`](internal.md#ffmceresbackend-kt-ceresnativelibrary) says where the library is
expected and how to build it.

`src/jvmMain/kotlin/afield/math/optimization/ceres/FfmCeresBackend.kt` — [read the source](source/jvmMain/afield/math/optimization/ceres/FfmCeresBackend/)

## actors.kt { #actors-kt }

Typed messages between boxes: a box registers a handler with [`onMessage`](internal.md#actors-kt--onmessage), and other code delivers
to it with [`send`](internal.md#actors-kt--send) (fire-and-forget) or [`sendAndAwait`](internal.md#actors-kt--sendandawait) (suspend for a reply).

Messages are queued per box and delivered on the next RunLoop frame. Handlers run as coroutines
on the RunLoop's dispatcher, so one can call [`MessageScope.frame`](internal.md#actors-kt--messagescope--frame) to wait a frame or
[`MessageScope.reply`](internal.md#actors-kt--messagescope--reply) to answer. A box with no handler for a payload type passes it to its
ancestors. [`go`](internal.md#actors-kt--go) launches a suspendable block owned by a box, so stopping the box cancels it and
its errors appear in the box's editor.

```diffstatic {data-lang=kotlin}
onMessage<String> { reply(payload.length) }
go { println(thisBox.sendAndAwait<String, Int>("hello")) }
```

`src/jvmMain/kotlin/afield/runtime/execution/actors.kt` — [read the source](source/jvmMain/afield/runtime/execution/actors/)

**Used in:** [A Terminal in a Box](../terminal.md)

## SourceBackedBlock.kt { #sourcebackedblock-kt }

A callable block that keeps the Kotlin source it was written as, and can be rebuilt from that
source after it has been saved.

The `sourceBlock` macro makes a [`SourceBackedBlock`](internal.md#sourcebackedblock-kt-sourcebackedblock) holding both a live lambda and its source. A
block restored from storage has only the source and rebuilds itself by evaluating it on its box's
engine. Doing that while the same box's code is running would run that code again, so it is
refused with [`SourceBackedBlockSelfBoxReentry`](internal.md#sourcebackedblock-kt-sourcebackedblockselfboxreentry) or [`SourceBackedBlockDuringOwnBody`](internal.md#sourcebackedblock-kt-sourcebackedblockduringownbody), each of whose
messages says where to invoke the block instead.

`src/jvmMain/kotlin/afield/study/source/SourceBackedBlock.kt` — [read the source](source/jvmMain/afield/study/source/SourceBackedBlock/)

### SourceBackedBlockSelfBoxReentry { #sourcebackedblock-kt-sourcebackedblockselfboxreentry }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nf">SourceBackedBlockSelfBoxReentry</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">box</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Box</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">source</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">IllegalStateException</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;This source-backed block is evaluating its stored source in box '${box.name}' (${box.id}) — the &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;box that is running it, whose body it therefore re-runs, once per invocation, until the stack &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;overflows. Source: '${source.take(80).replace('&#92;n', ' ')}'. &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;Invoke it somewhere that is not this box's own body: &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;(1) from another box — construct it with that box's id, &#96;SourceBackedBlock&lt;Any?&gt;(&#92;&quot;other&#95;box&#92;&quot;, source)&#96;, &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;and invoke it there, which is the split &#96;dev&#95;docs/agents/transcripts/keyframe&#95;code&#95;blend.yaml&#96; uses; &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;(2) from a frame loop or a control callback, after this body has finished; or &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;(3) not at all — a block the &#96;sourceBlock { }&#96; macro made in &#42;this&#42; execution carries a live &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;lambda, never hydrates, and is safe to call immediately. &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;See dev&#95;docs/FN&#95;REWRITE&#95;SELF&#95;BOX&#95;REENTRY.md.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/study/source/SourceBackedBlock/#L83)

Thrown when a rehydrating [`SourceBackedBlock`](internal.md#sourcebackedblock-kt-sourcebackedblock) would be evaluated in a box whose body is already running — the failure that was 327 nested body runs and 355 seconds before it was guarded.

### SourceBackedBlockDuringOwnBody { #sourcebackedblock-kt-sourcebackedblockduringownbody }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nf">SourceBackedBlockDuringOwnBody</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">box</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Box</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">source</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">IllegalStateException</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;This saved block (source '${source.take(80).replace('&#92;n', ' ')}') belongs to box '${box.name}', whose &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;code is running now, and hydrating it there would run that code again. Invoke it from a frame loop &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;or a control callback, after the box's code has finished, or from another box.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/study/source/SourceBackedBlock/#L100)

A saved block asked to hydrate on its own box's engine while that box's body is running. Evaluating it there would run the body again, so it is an error, raised before anything runs twice.
